label: prose:sm-params-theta-qcd
title: The strong-CP angle (1)
html:
Parameter Framework status
\theta_{\mathrm{QCD}} open — no construction offered here

The strong-CP angle is entirely open: nothing in this paper predicts \theta_{\mathrm{QCD}} or solves the strong-CP problem. One speculative direction can be named without endorsement: the framework's framing phase q^{w \cdot c} is a topological angle attached to crossings, which is the same kind of object as a \theta-term, and its per-crossing coupling is already structurally fixed at c = 1/2 by the Coulomb-charge definition. Whether the observed smallness of \theta_{\mathrm{QCD}} could arise from the framing sector is a question, not a claim; the framing phase's derived readings (charge and isospin) are already spoken for, and a full derivation would first require the \mathrm{SU}(3) sector itself, which is open.

A first probe of this direction (audit 2026-08-02-theta-qcd-framing-phase-cp-route) isolates one algebraic step. Charge conjugation acts on the Hecke fibre as the bar-involution q \mapsto q^{-1}, which on the substrate circle is complex conjugation; so a colour sector whose total framing phase is bar-symmetric (CP-even) would have a real framing phase, forcing \theta_{\mathrm{QCD}} \in \{0, \pi\}. That reality implication is proved sorry-free over a generic base ring. It is not a solution: the CP-evenness hypothesis is undischarged — a single T(2,9) gluon knot has writhe 9 \neq 0 and is maximally chiral, so CP-evenness would need a colour-singlet writhe cancellation over the 9 = 3 \times 3 tube structure, which requires the \mathrm{SU}(3) sector, itself open. Moreover \{0, \pi\} is a discrete prediction, not the observed |\theta_{\mathrm{QCD}}| < 10^{-10} smallness, which remains open.
